raw_segments.text: Cleopatra. Antony did tell me of you, bade me trust you, but I do not greatly care to
be deceived that have no use for trusting. If your master would have a queen his beggar,
you must tell him that majesty, to keep decorum, must no less beg than a kingdom. If he pleased
to give me conquered Egypt for my son, he gives me so much of mine own as I will kneel
